label: Actual paths give support coverage via their last edge (inference)
rule: Actual guarded support paths, explicit source scope and existing transitive-closure well-foundedness
meaning: Eliminate the NONEMPTY actual path: its last edge supplies some concrete existing actual supporter of the SAME target. That supporter may differ from the original off-world source. Zero-length reachability would not suffice. No J1, reflexivity, WF, source population or God identification is assumed.
